acceptanceCriteria: confirmed: schemas/playbook-registry-v1.schema.json is the closed Draft 2020-12 structural authority for the documented finite V1 registry and accepts no extra properties.
confirmed: playbooks/playbook-registry-v1.json contains exactly the documented registry identity, P1-004 deny-taxonomy reference, and one disabled Tier 0 shadow content-schema-repair entry.

confirmed: The single entry has productionWritePermission false, empty permittedTools and permittedPaths, exact fixture-only trigger and evidence requirements, exact deterministic check identifiers, no activation approval, zero retries, and no-mutation rollback.

confirmed: node tests/playbooks/validate-playbook-registry-v1.mjs loads only the committed canonical schema and artifact, validates the finite contract, and rejects the focused mutations defined by the design.

confirmed: Malformed JSON, altered authority, unexpected fields or values, activation, production-write permission, tools, paths, retries, or mutation-capable rollback fail deterministically with a nonzero exit.

confirmed: P1-006 adds no runtime runner, dispatcher, evaluator dependency, service, command execution, telemetry, rate calculator, runtime metric storage, external data, database, network call, credential access, production behavior, or package restructuring.
